name: Lean.ConstructorVal.rec
typeText:
{motive : Lean.ConstructorVal → Sort u} →
  ((toConstantVal : Lean.ConstantVal) →
      (induct : Lean.Name) →
        (cidx numParams numFields : Nat) →
          (isUnsafe : Bool) →
            motive
              { toConstantVal := toConstantVal, induct := induct, cidx := cidx, numParams := numParams,
                numFields := numFields, isUnsafe := isUnsafe }) →
    (t : Lean.ConstructorVal) → motive t

source.code:
structure ConstructorVal extends ConstantVal where
  /-- Inductive type this constructor is a member of -/
  induct  : Name
  /-- Constructor index (i.e., Position in the inductive declaration) -/
  cidx    : Nat
  /-- Number of parameters in inductive datatype. -/
  numParams : Nat
  /-- Number of fields (i.e., arity - nparams) -/
  numFields : Nat
  isUnsafe : Bool
  deriving Inhabited, BEq
